title: doc-kit features of a project (features.json)
description: The features of the application (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.8), written by `doc-kit inventory --features --write` and completed by hand or by the skill's agents: what each feature's sheet covers, and where its code is. Read by the `features` coverage adapter, by `context` and by `sync` (the files of a feature sheet, §6.10).

id.description: The id of the feature (F-01), the `feature` field of its sheet in toc.json.

routes.description: The screen routes of the feature (/orders, /orders/[id]).

api.description: Its API routes, "METHOD /path" or a path (GET /api/orders).

keys.description: Its i18n keys or their prefixes.

sources.description: Globs of the code behind it, relative to app.dir (lib/orders/**, services/search.py): read by context and followed by sync.

behaviours.description: The kinds of behaviour its sheet must describe with a card (standard/behaviours.json: search, filter…), deduced by inventory --features or written by hand.
